quotes.text: Learn how to charge an existing payment method while a customer is on-session.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: You’re responsible for your compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and network rules when saving a customer’s payment details.
Create a [PaymentIntent](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/create.md) to try to charge the customer with the payment method they selected.

findings: Semantic raw delta is navigation/presentation only: new raw lines 5-17 retain the on-session purpose and expose five web routes (Stripe-hosted page, Full embedded page, Elements, Custom flow, Direct API). Old raw lines 8-10, 205-207, 502-504, 896-898, and 1448-1452 already held those five detailed sections. Diff lines 1-13 and 1617-1621 show the body replaced by an index; the concatenation at diff line 1617 is a diff artifact, so raw files control. No new functional behavior, eligibility, API version, or payment result is established.

Baseline route error: current source lines 13-22 and Stripe index line 554 say four paths and omit the Direct API; concept stripe-saved-payment-methods line 158 repeats this. Old raw lines 1448-1456 and 1545-1590 already describe Direct API list/display plus server-created, confirmed PaymentIntent and status check, and new raw lines 13-17 explicitly route it. Correct all affected route counts to five and add a source-level Direct API locator; do not attribute the fifth path to November as a new feature.

Baseline overbroad common rules: current source lines 24-36 combine Checkout-only `allow_redisplay_filters`, 50-card display, card prefill and 30-minute prefill timeout as general rules. Old raw lines 12, 84-98, 161-183 establish these for hosted Checkout, repeated for embedded and Elements at old raw lines 209, 276-290, 458-480, 506, 563-577, 772-794. The custom PaymentIntent/CustomerSession flow instead enables `payment_method_redisplay` with a customer/account identifier and uses `payment_method_allow_redisplay_filters` (old raw lines 917-999 and 1001-1063), while Direct API lists selected PaymentMethods with its `allow_redisplay` query (old raw lines 1454-1486, 1488-1527). Keep the three API parameter names and object identities distinct.

Baseline consequential omission: the old guide expressly requires consent for the specific future use before rendering saved details (old raw lines 84-98, 563-577, 1001-1013, 1488-1500); current source lines 24-40 discusses redisplay values and limits but omits this compliance warning. It also omits the separate Direct API declined 402, requires_action/handleNextAction, and PaymentIntent status/event boundary at old raw lines 1545-1616. A list result, created Intent, client return, or actions-handled example is not a succeeded payment.

Old raw lines 32-40, 214-222, 511-519, and 919-927 distinguish customer-configured Accounts v2 from Customers v1, and date Accounts v2 availability as generally available for Connect but preview for other Stripe users with preview version. Current source lines 19-22 correctly list alternative identifiers but do not preserve the dated preview qualification. Old raw lines 185-203, 876-894 are Checkout events, whereas old raw lines 1434-1446 and 1604-1616 are PaymentIntent events; current source lines 42-44 lists only Checkout events under an unqualified heading.

source_assessments.reason: The new capture only changes navigation and provenance, but the existing summary contains material baseline route-count, scope, consent, and outcome omissions requiring correction.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/existing-customers, the complete November capture establishes an on-session existing-payment-method guide and five web routes, including Direct API (new raw lines 5-17); it supplies no current implementation or payment result. The May 11 capture separately describes Checkout Sessions for hosted, embedded, and Elements UIs using an existing customer-configured Account or Customer, with conditional saved-card display and prefill (old raw lines 8-183, 205-290, 502-577), a custom PaymentIntent plus CustomerSession with payment_method_redisplay enabled for the matching Account or Customer (old raw lines 896-999), and Direct API list, confirm, and status handling (old raw lines 1448-1616). The May guide also requires consent for the specific future use before rendering saved details (old raw lines 84-98). source-stripe-payments-existing-customers.md says four paths and omits Direct API at current source lines 13-22; it also treats Checkout-specific prefill and Checkout events as broadly common at lines 24-44.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/existing-customers, the November difference is presentation/navigation: five variant links (new raw lines 9-17) replace the May 11 detailed body (old raw lines 8-1616), without evidence of substantive behavior change or deprecation. source-stripe-payments-existing-customers.md must retain dated body provenance while correcting its old four-path error, separating Checkout filters and prefill from custom CustomerSession filters and Direct API listing (current source lines 13-44; old raw lines 84-98, 917-1063, 1448-1527). The May 11 Accounts v2 preview/version caveat and specific-use consent warning remain dated (old raw lines 32-40, 84-98). Checkout Session events and PaymentIntent status/events are distinct (old raw lines 185-203, 1434-1446, 1583-1616); creating a Session or Intent, displaying a saved method, redirecting, or handling an action cannot establish payment success.
